purpose: Design of the agenda mechanism: a shared storage layer that records agenda items (review findings, discussion points), judges state transitions, and triggers display generation for consult.
summary: Overview and one-way architecture: consult, agenda_wrapper, agenda_store, agenda_render
Module list and class diagram of the agenda.json data structure
JSON schema fields: content_version, config, structural_judgment, items, decision, last_changed_fields
State expressed by the three decision values being non-empty, with no separate status vocabulary
Transition conditions in agenda_schema and structural judgment re-required when adding items
Input CLI design via agenda_wrapper: start, record one value per call, next, pending, finish
Location, count and lifetime of records per origin (review, consult)
Automatic re-render trigger after writes and failure handling
Test design and measurement method for FNC-004
tasks: Implementing or modifying agenda_store, agenda_wrapper or agenda_schema
Integrating consult with the agenda mechanism
Writing tests for the agenda mechanism
title: DES-075 agenda 機構 設計書
